nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. óstáin / leabharlanna / scoileanna) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: the six retained legacy segment cards keep their IDs and stay the card unit, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (19 questions: eighteen at 3 and Fógra a Dó Ceist 2 at 3 + 3; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card (already carded, IDs retained). Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email and conversation partner wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24, B 24, C 12; every question 3 marks except Fógra a Dó Ceist 2 at 3 + 3) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).

Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” (scheme PDF 3 and 9) is one section-level deduction; cards state it without applying it. Printed partial answers: Rang(anna) = 1, Ceol = 2, Halla = 2, Seomraí/Ionad = 2, Dúnta = 2, Múinteoir = 2, Ionad = 2.
Composition 40-mark table (PDF 12) with short-attempt columns M/F1/F2/F3 (36/30/20/10, PDF 13); those columns include odd values, so the Cumas Gaeilge award takes any value 0–40.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each segment card had one undivided criterion; the nine composition cards carried short paraphrased notes. All now carry the lifted 2024 scheme text and per-question tariffs.
